reviews.title: Location Great Reception Staff Excellent, Basic. Slamming Doors Stuffy Rooms, Dirty Bathrooms
reviews.positive_text: Although the reception staff are only behind a tablet screen, they are excellent and friendly. I arrived on Monday 12 October and was greeted by a really nice girl who helped and was very accommodating. The Wi-Fi was good. The room had everything required for a basic stay. The location is excellent. The price was okay but still a bit higher than what I think is value for money considering the issues and lack of sleep and comfort overall that was affected by things that shouldn't happen.
reviews.negative_text: If you're happy with constant slamming of doors that cut through every single bone in your body, a stuffy room, and dirty bathrooms that don't get cleaned often then this is the place for you. The staff and other guests just don't give a crap about anyone else and constantly slam doors at any time. I was woken up multiple times every single night around 1am, 2am, 3am no one gives a sh1t. The staff used a room next to mine that was slammed every 2 minutes, and I was ready to ram their heads through the door and watch them bleed out. The room was stuffy and there's no fan to help and staff couldn't be bothered to get one. The shared bathroom was cleaned maybe once in 4 days and is pretty bad.
reviews.hotel_response: Thank you for sharing your detailed feedback. We're glad to hear that our reception team made you feel welcome, particularly the staff member who assisted you on 12 October. It's also good to know that the WiFi, the room and our location met your needs. We're very sorry to hear about the constant door slamming, the stuffy room and the condition of the shared bathroom during your stay. Noise at night and a lack of ventilation can make rest very difficult. We understand how frustrating this was. Your comments have been shared with our housekeeping and maintenance teams so the bathroom cleaning schedule and the supply of fans can be reviewed. We will also review how noise is managed across the property, particularly at night. Thank you again for bringing these matters to our attention. We apologise that we fell short and we hope to provide you with a much better experience in the future.

reviews.positive_text: We had a really great stay and would definitely recommend this hotel! The room was very clean, well organised and comfortable, and everything was exactly as we expected. The Wi-Fi worked perfectly throughout our stay, and the access system with the entry code was very simple, convenient and made everything feel easy and secure. A special thank you to Alona and Julie, who were absolutely amazing and so friendly! Even though the reception process was virtual when we arrived, they assisted us through the computer with the check-in and made the whole experience incredibly smooth. Everything was explained clearly, communication was excellent, and the process was quick and straightforward with no unnecessary complications or bureaucracy. We really appreciated how helpful, patient and welcoming they were. The location is also very convenient. It’s easy to get around using public transport, and being close to Allianz stadium and Bondi Beach is definitely a big plus, especially if you want to explore one of Sydney’s most popular areas. Overall, we really enjoyed the practicality of the hotel, the cleanliness, the location and especially the excellent customer service. Everything worked perfectly from check-in to check-out. Thank you again to Alona and Julie for making our stay even better. We would happily stay here again!

En plus du manque total d’hygiène, la sécurité laisse également à désirer : des multiprises sont branchées les unes sur les autres, créant un risque électrique et un potentiel danger d’incendie. Un établissement aussi sale que dangereux, où les conditions d’hébergement sont tout simplement inacceptables et surtout : pas de remboursement ou de geste commercial malgré tout ça. Une expérience vraiment décevante, je ne recommande absolument pas cet établissement.

reviews.positive_text: Комната нормальная в которой жил, вид на мост Харбор и Оперу Сиднея. Расположение хорошее
reviews.negative_text: Начнем с заселения, приходит сообщение от отеля, что необходимо зарегистрироваться онлайн, но в сообщении нет никаких ссылок или QR кода для регистрации онлайн, я прилетел в Сидней и написал им в 1:30PM, с вопросом где регистрироваться онлайн, но ответа так и не поступило, хотя пишут что отвечают на сообщения в букинге и по почте своей, я решил ехать в отель. Приехал в отель в 3:00PM, на двери есть QR-код для регистрации, я зарегистрировался и перешел в приложение GOKI, но там сказано было что вы не зарегистрированы и соответственно нет никаких кодов для того, чтобы попасть в комнату и внутрь здания! В итоге я простоял на улице у двери в отель под дождем до практически 05:00PM, так как никто не отвечал на мои сообщения по почте, в букинге, в ватсап с 1:30PM! Ответили только ближе к 5 вечера, и пришлось ждать когда мне отправят коды от дверей! Причина в том, что якобы сотрудник не видел мои сообщения!!! В общем много времени потрачено впустую при онлайн заселении. По поводу хранения багажа, если вы привыкли оставлять в отеле, то это не ваш вариант, оставить можно только до полудня! И они могли бы пойти мне навстречу, с учетом того, что два часа я не мог попасть в свою комнату, но нет, мне отказали, можно только до полудня, а у меня вылет был вечером! Из-за проблем с регистрацией я не смог зарегистрироваться на ужин. По поводу чистоты, ну помойте вы уже окна в комнатах с «видом» на мост и оперу, там просто разглядеть надо все через эту грязь. В зоне кухни грязно, ремонт сделан приятный в светлых тонах, но везде грязь! Грязные раковины, зона готовки, в раковине еда, посуда не мытая! В общем сначала хотел забронировать еще на 6 ночей через неделю, но это того не стоит, поэтому передумал.

reviews.title: BAD - but year before not bad bunk beds that dont move, cheap ad cheerful good location
reviews.positive_text: I had stayed at this property several times last year, and while the customer service wasn’t always outstanding, I understood it’s a hostel environment. However, during one stay, I was placed right next to a bathroom, and there was constant door slamming throughout the night (2–4am). Understandably, I was frustrated and contacted reception via the intercom. Unfortunately, I was told there were no options to move rooms and that I would just have to put up with it. The following morning, the manager informed me that I was no longer welcome, despite having stayed there for nearly two months the previous year and across multiple locations. I found this response extreme and unjustified. When I tried to discuss the situation, the manager was combative, dismissive, and ultimately hung up on me, stating he didn’t care and that I was effectively evicted. I also later received a note about a bottle of rosé wine, even though I was not drinking and have never done so on the premises, which added to the confusion. I want to highlight that Lia, a staff member, consistently provided excellent customer service—professional, helpful, and respectful at all times. Months later, when I returned to Sydney, I even apologized in an attempt to stay again, though I’m not sure why I felt the need to. My reservation was declined regardless. Overall, the situation felt disproportionate and poorly handled. I was left confused, as the outcome didn’t seem to match the circumstances.

Regarding your concerns about communication and the outcome of your stay, we take all guest interactions seriously. Decisions relating to guest stays and future bookings are made in line with internal policies and after careful consideration of relevant circumstances. These decisions are not taken lightly and are based on maintaining a safe and respectful environment for both guests and staff. We regret that your experience did not meet your expectations. La ubicación es excelente si te interesan las fiestas en la zona de Kings Cross (como La Cueva, una de las principales fiestas latinas de Sydney), muchos restaurantes cerca, y está a pocos metros de la estación de tren del mismo nombre que te lleva a la ciudad o a Bondi Junction (desde donde puedes tomar buses hacia Bondi Beach). Las literas son normales, ni duras ni muy cómodas.
reviews.negative_text: Roomies muy desordenados, dejaban todo tirado. A mi litera le faltaba la repisa para poner cosas que todas las demás sí tenían, y la luz personal estaba desconectada de la corriente (nunca hallé la toma correspondiente). Pocos baños para la cantidad de huéspedes, aunque esperable en una casa antigua reconvertida. La cena a menudo era carente de proteína, y la zanahoria en la ensalada era literalmente incomible por ser tan dura. Vi una cucaracha muerta en el comedor secundario y, al día siguiente, otra pequeña y mojada sobre la encimera. Muchos huecos sin tapar por donde otras cucarachas podrían colarse, aunque en fin, así es Sydney. El comedor principal al parecer se limpia semanalmente, porque siempre lo vi sucio. El camino a la lavandería está muy desordenado y luce bastante mal.

reviews.title: Not as advertised and poorly maintained.
reviews.negative_text: Unfortunately, this hostel does not match the photos or description shown on Booking. The exterior and interior look significantly different from what is advertised, and the overall condition of the property is far below expectations. There is also inconsistent information provided to guests. The document sent at check-in states that check-in is at 2:00pm, yet staff strictly enforce a 3:00pm check-in and explained that the document is “outdated.” If policies have changed, official documents provided to guests should be updated accordingly to avoid confusion. Check-in is restricted due to “cleaning,” however, upon arrival, the room was clearly not properly cleaned. Floors were not vacuumed, trash was left behind, and during my three-night stay, the room was never cleaned. The document also states that bed sheets are changed daily unless requested otherwise and that rooms are cleaned every day. Neither of these services were provided. On my last day, after previous guests checked out, I pointed out leftover trash to the cleaning staff. When I returned later that evening, the trash was still there. The only action taken was placing a new garbage bag. There is only one bathroom per floor for approximately four or five rooms, resulting in constant queues. The bathroom was noisy, poorly maintained, and lacked basic amenities. Towels are not provided and cost $10 to rent, which is significantly higher than typical hostel rates. Breakfast and dinner are advertised as included, but both are offered only within a very limited one-hour window, which is impractical given the number of guests. Dinner was extremely basic, with no beverages included. When water was requested, only tap water was offered. Considering the overall hygiene standards of the property, this was concerning. There is no physical reception — communication is via a remote screen, and assistance was limited and inconsistent.

Also the day I was checking out, the other receptionist told me I can store my backpack till 2pm and when I asked if I can pick it up at 3pm she just repeated the same sentence. The hostel costs 75$ a night, I should be about to at least leave my bag there when I wait for my flight. It’s ridiculous. Also to rent a towel is $15. We appreciate your comments and will continue to review ways to improve guest experience.

reviews.title: Hemsk
reviews.positive_text: Ingenting.
reviews.negative_text: När vi kom till rummet var det ett HELT ANNAT rum än det som var på Booking. Det var otroligt mörkt, smutsigt och extremt slitet. AC:n var portabel och lät extremt mycket samtidigt som det gick en stor slang ut ur fönstret som var öppet. Det var slarvigt tejpat så fönstret hade fortfarande ett öppet hål längst ner. Detta bjöd in rök lukt från de som stod och rökte utanför entrén samt kackerlackor. Badrummen var otroligt smutsiga och det var svartmögel vart man än titta. Vi insåg direkt att vi hade blivit scammade och tog kontakt med ”receptionen” som var en person i en IPad i hallen. Det sa att det skulle titta på rummet vilket det gjorde, personalen som kolla sa att vi hade fått fel rum och att han höll med om att det absolut inte var samma rum. De sa att vi kunde byta till det rätta rummet dagen efter men INTE få återbetalt för natten i det hemska rummet vi hade. De sa även att det inte var återbetalningsbart trots att det inte appliceras i fall där kunden har blivit SCAMMAD. Till slut går det med på att återbetala om vi lämnar SAMMA KVÄLL, klockan var 20:00 och det var otroligt påfrestande. Vi fråga om det gick bra att byta till det rätta rummet morgonen efter då vi inte kunde hitta boende. ”Kundtjänst” sa då följande: Ni har fått rätt rum, alla de privata rummet ser ut så, bilderna på Booking är bara ”refrensbilder” - trots att de hade sagt att vi fick fel rum? Vi fick tag på Booking som hjälpte oss att få full återbetalning och vi lämnade samma kväll. Kort sagt, rummen ser inte ALLS ut som de gör på bilderna och jag avråder samtliga personer från att bo här.
reviews.hotel_response: Thank you for sharing your feedback. We sincerely apologise for the negative experience you had during your stay. We understand how upsetting it must have been to feel that the room did not meet your expectations and to experience issues with cleanliness, AC, and overall comfort. We also regret the confusion regarding the room assignment and any miscommunication about the photos on Booking.com. Our intention is never to mislead guests — the images are meant to represent the room type generally, but we acknowledge that this may not have reflected your specific room accurately, and we are reviewing our listings to prevent similar misunderstandings. We are glad that our team and Booking.com were able to assist with a full refund and resolve the situation, but we sincerely apologise for the stress caused. Your feedback is extremely important, and we will use it to improve our room presentation, maintenance, and guest communication going forward. Thank you for bringing these concerns to our attention.

reviews.title: Stinky, poor, and unhappy
reviews.positive_text: I did not like anything
reviews.negative_text: This is by far the worst hostel I’ve ever stayed at in my life! Dirty, smelly... the room stank so bad I could barely sleep. There’s only one women’s bathroom with 2 toilets and 2 showers—for the entire hostel! No security, no privacy. The kitchen was disgusting: dirty pots, plates, cups, everything! People leave a mess and there’s nobody to clean it up. There’s no reception—just one person online talking to you through a camera and a computer screen. The ad claims the rooms have air conditioning—total lie! The room is hot, the bed is terrible. There’s not a single common area. Just a filthy kitchen with a table and chairs, and some weird cubicle with benches. So forget trying to arrive early, relax, charge your phone, hang out, or meet anyone—impossible! Rotten place. I would never go back, I’d rather sleep in the subway. I paid way too much because they lie in their ads, while there are so many better, cheaper hostels with friendly, attentive staff. I already know hostel service in Australia can be poor, but this place took mediocrity to a whole new level. My advice? Don’t stay here—unless you want to punish yourself, or hope they either go out of business or actually improve. Total trash.

reviews.negative_text: The kitchen is full of fruit flies, the bathrooms are constantly wet, (but pressure and water temperature are good) kitchenware is poorly washed and the place is older and beaten up compared to what is shown on booking. Only 1 bathroom per floor in my building and some nights I had to go in the building next door (part of the hostel) to use the toilet. At checkout, I was out of the room early, but I had a few trips up and down the stairs to take my suitcase and backpacks and they changed the code to gate and room and it was a struggle to get my stuff. Just give a 20 minutes window?! We are leaving, Jezzzz. Food seems to be like a little buffet from the pictures but it isn't. I do not recommend it if you have allergies, it doesn't seem like the place who would be able to respect cross contamination and so on. Also with the condition of the kitchen, I didn't feel like eating there either. Bring some good earplugs cause the AC will scream if turned on. There's no in person receptionist, just remotely through the screen. If you're on a budget, it's fine, it's also close to the metro and it's easy to get there from the airport.

Zudem wirkt auch der Außenbereich nicht so gepflegt und definitiv nicht so wie auf den Bildern. Vor dem Hostel haben sich teilweise sehr suspekte Menschen versammelt, wodurch ich mich selbst, gerade abends, einfach nicht so wohl gefühlt habe. Oftmals hat unser Zimmer abends deshalb auch sehr nach Gras gerochen, da diese Leute eben vor der Tür gekifft haben - für mich persönlich nicht so angenehm und hat nicht dafür gesorgt, dass ich mich wohl gefühlt habe.

reviews.negative_text: Der Check-in erfolgt nicht persönlich, sondern über eine Rezeptionistin per Video. Der Hausmeister öffnete uns nach einiger Zeit die Tür, wir konnten das Zimmer aber nicht mehr verlassen, da der Code nicht funktionierte. Ein weiterer Gast, welchen ich um Hilfe bat, sagte aus, dass auch sein Zimmercode nicht funktioniere und er deshalb ständig einen Schuh in die Zimmertür stellen musste, damit ihm der Eintritt jederzeit möglich war. Zudem wurden wir um 21.30 Uhr von einem Angestellten aufgefordert, die Zimmertür zu öffnen, denn er wollte an der Decke einen Rauchmelder installieren. Er erklärte es sei ein Notfall, wir hörten die Bohrmaschine aus den Nebenzimmern. Erst nach mehrmaligem intensiven Verneinen unsererseits entfernte sich der Angestellte und ließ uns schlussendlich in Ruhe. Das Zimmer war extrem klein (2x3m)und man konnte sich kaum umdrehen, da die Koffer auf dem Boden ausgepackt werden mussten. Der Preis war meiner Meinung nicht gerechtfertigt, es fehlte auch die Sauberkeit und ein einfacher angemessener Komfort.

The price is the best and the reason I will keep coming back. It's location so close to the station and the price. Perfect.
reviews.negative_text: The room itself was sooo hot. I actually was sick for a few days after I checked out simply due to there being no ventilation in the room. With several roommates mentioning they were sick already. The aircon was off or broken and no windows were open. It was so stuffy and definitely contributed or entirely was the reason I was ill after. I've no way to know if the five dollars I rented for the plastic container for the fridge was reimbursed. That part felt super dodgy. I had a few books I would have left if there was a space to put them. My upper bunk needed a shelf to put things. I had no shelf at all. I saw some beds did have them, so they need to be all double checked they're there. The pillow was super uncomfy and made my neck sore. Offering a second would have been great. The norm in dorm rooms I've noticed is to generally "steal" an unoccupied beds pillow or swap for the better one. Making them all good would stop this.

reviews.negative_text: Horrible experience checking in with Reyna and Sophia. I messaged them at 11:00 in the morning to let them know that I wanted dinner. I also completed the online check-in, uploaded all my details, and was told I would receive a door code. I arrived at the hotel at 7:00 pm and immediately emailed them and sent messages through Booking.com. Reyna ignored these messages until 7:42 pm. When I finally spoke to her, I was given a series of different and contradictory explanations. First, I was told that none of my emails or Booking.com messages had been received. When I showed her evidence that they had been sent, the explanations changed. I was then kept waiting for another 15 minutes while further explanations were given. I finally got through the door at around 8:00 pm. I went to get the dinner I had requested earlier, only to find that there was no dinner available. I went back to reception to speak to Reyna, and again I was given a series of explanations that contradicted what I had previously been told. I was left standing at reception with all my bags until approximately 8:20 pm. Reyna then gave me the wrong door code and refused to provide the contact details for her manager or supervisor. By contrast, the gentleman who is normally on the screen on a Friday night has always been excellent and provides a completely different level of customer service. My impression was that Reyna was worried about her handling of the situation being exposed, which is why I felt I was given different explanations, my questions weren't properly answered, and I was refused the manager's email address. This was an absolutely horrible experience. The whole situation was unnecessarily stressful and time-consuming. Reyna's handling of the situation was extremely poor.

While we appreciate that you contacted us earlier in the day regarding dinner, our complimentary dinner is served only during the designated dinner service period. As we do not reserve or hold individual portions, we’re unable to guarantee a meal for guests who arrive after the dinner service has ended. This is in place to help us manage food safely and fairly for all guests. That said, we acknowledge that this should have been communicated clearly to you in advance, particularly after you had contacted us about dinner. We apologise for any misunderstanding or inconvenience this caused. Regarding the check-in and door-code issues, we understand how frustrating it must have been to wait with your luggage and receive an incorrect code. We are reviewing the circumstances and communication with the team involved to ensure that guests receive clear and accurate information and prompt assistance when issues arise. We appreciate your feedback and are sorry that your arrival did not reflect the level of service we aim to provide.

They provide luggage storage but in another hotel of the same brand (15 mins way), fortunately they did me a favor and we could have left there one of our backpack until 6 pm but the normal hour of the storage is until 12 pm. reviews.title: Muy buena ubicación y relación calidad-precio, con algunos detalles operativos
reviews.positive_text: La ubicación es excelente: está muy bien conectado y se puede llegar fácilmente desde el aeropuerto en metro, prácticamente sales de la estación y estás ahí. Las habitaciones son cómodas para ser un hostel, con buen ambiente y huéspedes respetuosos. Tiene buen WiFi, cocina equipada para guardar comida, varias duchas y baños disponibles, y servicios como lavandería que hacen la estancia práctica. En general, ofrece una muy buena relación calidad-precio considerando lo céntrico que es.
reviews.negative_text: El acceso con equipaje puede ser incómodo, ya que hay escaleras y las habitaciones están en el segundo o tercer piso, y esto podría comunicarse mejor en el anuncio para que los huéspedes estén más preparados. Tampoco es muy práctico el servicio de storage gratuito que ofrecen: tuve que caminar hasta otra propiedad de la misma cadena, lo que implicó una subir la cuestas de Surry Hills y es una caminata de unos 30 minutos, pero es más rápido si se hace en Uber. El sistema de recepción es remoto (pantallas con atención desde fuera del país), lo que puede hacer el check-in más lento o confuso. Además, las puertas con código a veces fallan, lo cual puede ser incómodo. Finalmente, al estar en una zona con vida nocturna, puede haber algo de ruido los fines de semana, y la limpieza es correcta pero no impecable.
reviews.hotel_response: Thanks for your detailed feedback! 😊 We’re glad you enjoyed the location, atmosphere, and overall value. We appreciate your comments about access, luggage handling, and check-in—we’ll work on improving communication and convenience. Your notes on noise and cleanliness are also noted. Hope to welcome you again!

reviews.negative_text: I arrived to my room and found that the carpet was very wet and as a result the room smelled extremely musty and mouldy. I couldn't take my shoes off in the room or I would soak my feet and socks. When I raised the issue with the accommodation, they did the bare minimum by putting a towel on the floor (half the room's carpet was wet) and leaving a bottle of disinfectant spray. No alternative room was arranged, and there was no initiative to offer compensation in any way. When I asked the issue to be escalated to management, they said it'd take 7-10 business days and when I waited 10 business days I had to follow up again because I hadn't heard anything. This place clearly thinks they can offer poor services and get away with it. I know they offer cheap rooms, so I was expecting something quite modest and minimal, but a room with a soaking wet floor is a whole new level of poor quality. Do NOT recommend.

reviews.positive_text: Die Lageist Ok, aber trotzdem ein gutes Stück zB zu "The Rocks".
reviews.negative_text: Ich kann das Hotel nicht empfehlen. Kein gutes Preis/ Leistungsverhältnis. Ich habe 100€ pro Nacht in einem 6 Bett Zimmer bezahlt. Zimmer ausreichen, Bäder unzureichend. Nur der Essraum als Gemeinschaftsraum, Frühstück spärlich. Das Dinner war allerdings gut, die Lage ist auch gut. Überall hängen Hinweisschilder, dass videoüberwacht wird und die Höhe der verhängten Bußgelder, wenn man die Hausordnung nicht einhält. Auch noch nicht erlebt habe ich das strikte Verbot von Alkohol. Es gibt kein Personal vor Ort, die Rezeption ist ein Tablet. Der Checkin war holperig und hat bei mir online nicht wirklich funktioniert. Nach dem Aufenthalt ist es nicht möglich sein Gepäck dort für ein paar Stunden in einem Storrage zu lassen. Nur auf eigenes Risiko im Essraum, einen Gepäckraum gibt es nicht. Nicht empfehlenswert.
reviews.hotel_response: Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback. We’re sorry to hear that your stay did not fully meet your expectations. While we’re glad you enjoyed the dinner and found the location convenient, we regret that other aspects of your experience were disappointing. Our property operates with a self-service check-in system through a tablet to allow guests to check in efficiently, though we understand that this may not suit every traveler. Your comments regarding the bathrooms, common spaces, and the check-in process have been noted and shared with our team as we continuously work to improve the guest experience. We also appreciate your feedback regarding our house rules and security measures, which are in place to ensure a safe and comfortable environment for all guests. Thank you again for your feedback, and we hope to have the opportunity to provide a better experience in the future.

Location was great, public transportation is close and basic restaurants and shops were close. The place was calm and quiet. It didn’t get too hot in the night. Staff were nice and friendly!
reviews.negative_text: It was pretty hard to get warm water from the showers. It was either too hot or too cold. Also the showers were pretty out dated and had some mold on the wall seams. And there wasn’t any surface to put your clothes or shampoos etc. on where they could stay dry during showering. And the bathroom floors were always wet (maybe putting some towels on the floors would be nice). The toilets were dirty couple of times, it isn’t the staffs fault tho:) Maybe couple more options for the breakfast and something to drink (juice etc) for the dinner.

reviews.title: Bad
reviews.positive_text: Location
reviews.negative_text: This place used to be good about five years ago, but unfortunately, the standard has deteriorated dramatically. It seems they have lowered their prices and opened the doors to just about anyone, and the overall environment has suffered as a result. The place is now extremely dirty and messy, with some residents leaving filthy, smelly clothes scattered around their rooms. There are people struggling with drug and alcohol problems, disruptive behaviour, and a general lack of consideration for others. Many appear to be staying long-term rather than being ordinary travellers or holidaymakers. The meals are incredibly basic and poor quality. Dinner is so cheap and unappealing that it feels more like a charity meal than something you'd expect from paid accommodation. To be fair, the Sydney staff do try to do a good job, and I acknowledge their efforts. However, the management appears to have little control over the standard of residents or the behaviour occurring on the premises. I've witnessed some extraordinary things, including someone running a power cord out of a window to charge an electric car parked in the driveway. Customer service is another major problem. The overseas customer service team can sometimes be helpful, but too often, instead of taking responsibility and resolving a complaint, they look for excuses and try to shift the blame back onto the customer. Questions such as why an issue wasn't reported earlier seem to take priority over actually addressing the problem. Management has apparently sent warnings about behaviour such as smoking drugs in rooms and urinating in bottles, yet the fact that such warnings are necessary tells you something about the environment. It's disappointing because this place had a good reputation years ago. The Sydney staff deserve credit for trying, but the overall management, cleanliness, resident standards, food quality and customer service have deteriorated significantly.
reviews.hotel_response: Thank you for sharing such detailed feedback. We're very sorry to hear that your experience fell so far below the standard you remember from previous stays. The issues you describe, including cleanliness in shared areas, the behaviour of some long-term residents and the quality of our meals, do not reflect the environment we want for our guests. We also regret that your interactions with our customer service team felt more focused on process than on resolving your concerns. We sincerely apologize for this. Your comments have been shared with our management, housekeeping and front office teams so the concerns you raised can be reviewed. We appreciate the efforts of our Sydney team. We are sorry that your stay did not reflect the welcoming and well-run property we aim to provide. Thank you again for bringing these matters to our attention. We wish you all the best in your future travels.

reviews.positive_text: Location
reviews.negative_text: Horrible experience checking in with Reyna and Sophia. I messaged them at 11:00 in the morning to let them know that I wanted dinner. I also completed the online check-in, uploaded all my details, and was told I would receive a door code. I arrived at the hotel at 7:00 pm and immediately emailed them and sent messages through Booking.com. Reyna ignored these messages until 7:42 pm. When I finally spoke to her, I was given a series of different and contradictory explanations. First, I was told that none of my emails or Booking.com messages had been received. When I showed her evidence that they had been sent, the explanations changed. I was then kept waiting for another 15 minutes while further explanations were given. I finally got through the door at around 8:00 pm. I went to get the dinner I had requested earlier, only to find that there was no dinner available. I went back to reception to speak to Reyna, and again I was given a series of explanations that contradicted what I had previously been told. I was left standing at reception with all my bags until approximately 8:20 pm. Reyna then gave me the wrong door code and refused to provide the contact details for her manager or supervisor. By contrast, the gentleman who is normally on the screen on a Friday night has always been excellent and provides a completely different level of customer service. My impression was that Reyna was worried about her handling of the situation being exposed, which is why I felt I was given different explanations, my questions weren't properly answered, and I was refused the manager's email address. This was an absolutely horrible experience. The whole situation was unnecessarily stressful and time-consuming. Reyna's handling of the situation was extremely poor.
reviews.hotel_response: We sincerely apologise for the difficulties you experienced during your arrival. Thank you for taking the time to share such detailed feedback. We’re very sorry that your check-in experience was stressful and that you experienced delays and confusion regarding your access code. We’d also like to clarify the dinner arrangement. While we appreciate that you contacted us earlier in the day regarding dinner, our complimentary dinner is served only during the designated dinner service period. As we do not reserve or hold individual portions, we’re unable to guarantee a meal for guests who arrive after the dinner service has ended. This is in place to help us manage food safely and fairly for all guests. That said, we acknowledge that this should have been communicated clearly to you in advance, particularly after you had contacted us about dinner. We apologise for any misunderstanding or inconvenience this caused. Regarding the check-in and door-code issues, we understand how frustrating it must have been to wait with your luggage and receive an incorrect code. We are reviewing the circumstances and communication with the team involved to ensure that guests receive clear and accurate information and prompt assistance when issues arise. We appreciate your feedback and are sorry that your arrival did not reflect the level of service we aim to provide.

reviews.title: Que sea barato no implica que su mantenimiento sea deficiente.
reviews.positive_text: Si estás valorando este hostel en tu estancia en Sydney posiblemente será por su ubicación y porque es de los que incluye desayuno y cena en el precio. Posiblemente ambos puntos son sus claras ventajas para decidirse frente a otros, aunque con matices. Respecto a la ubicación, personalmente creo que es su punto fuerte. Bien conectado a la estación central de tren, está en un punto que andando puedes llegar a Circular Quay en apenas 30-40 minutos andando a un ritmo normal. Estás en un punto que si te decides por ir a The Rocks, o a la zona de Chinatown, también está a menos de 30 minutos andando, por lo que estás prácticamente en el centro de todo. Si además planeas acercarte a Bondi Beach desde aquí, hay línea de autobús y en menos de 1h de trayecto estás allí con un solo transbordo. Otro de sus puntos positivos, en mi caso debo destacar las habitaciones. Literas rígidas y cómodas que no se mueven en absoluto (si has ido a otros hostel sabes de lo que hablo). Colchones decentes por el precio a pagar y habitación relativamente correcta en cuanto a espacio (al menos en las habitaciones de 6 personas). Por último, la parte del desayuno y cena que incluyen en el precio. Desde luego que es una ventaja frente a otras opciones de hostel que no incluyen nada. Desayuno básico que se sirve de 7:30am a 9am, incluye zumo, leche, té/café, cereales y pan de molde con diferentes mermeladas, mantequilla y crema de cacahuete. Eso es todo. Simple y básico. Y lo mismo ocurre en la cena. Horario de 18:30pm a 19:45pm, suelen ser platos básicos donde no podemos destacar que sean las mejores opciones nutritivamente hablando. Pasta algunos días, pollo con puré de patata otros, o arroz con carne picada. No esperes la mejor cena posible, de hecho da más sensación de comedor social que de hostel.
reviews.negative_text: Soy crítico porque en mis últimos 5 meses viajando he estado en muchos hostel y entiendo que si busco las opciones más económicas, renuncio a ciertas comodidades que otros más caros si me ofrecen (como más cantidad de baños, cocinas más grandes y más equipadas, zonas comunes de mejor calidad y más amplias, etc). Lo que no está bien es la falta de mantenimiento general del lugar. Es un hostel viejo si nos centramos en sus comodidades, y salvo las habitaciones que a mi parecer estaban en buen estado general, el resto fue bastante decepcionante. La mayoría de baños estaban viejos y no funcionaban como deberían. Ya sea un grifo roto, una ducha sin mucha presión de agua u otro con el suelo siempre con agua. Se notaba una falta de mantenimiento del lugar. Por no decir que en general estaban sucios. Paredes de las duchas por ejemplo que dudo se hayan limpiado en los últimos meses, papeleras llenas muchas ocasiones, y en definitiva, sensación de abandono. Por supuesto, entiendo que pagar un precio reducido por una noche en Sydney con desayuno y cena incluido, tienes que renunciar a cierto confort en tu estancia. Pero eso no implica llegar a un lugar con poco mantenimiento y con zonas sucias en general.

reviews.title: Bad
reviews.negative_text: ⸻ Sehr enttäuschender Aufenthalt Unser Aufenthalt in diesem Hostel war leider sehr enttäuschend. Auf den Bildern wirkte alles sehr gepflegt, relativ neu und durch die angeblichen 4 Sterne auch durchaus ansprechend. Vor Ort bot sich jedoch ein komplett anderes Bild. Bereits beim Betreten des Eingangs fiel ein sehr unangenehmer Geruch auf, der stark an einen nassen Hund erinnerte. Das gesamte Gebäude sowie die Zimmer machten einen stark heruntergekommenen Eindruck. Der Aufenthalts- bzw. Speiseraum war ungepflegt und überhaupt nicht einladend, um dort seine Mahlzeiten einzunehmen. Tische und Wände waren sichtbar dreckig. Die Toiletten erinnerten eher an öffentliche WCs am Hauptbahnhof – so unappetitlich, dass man sich regelrecht davor ekelte, dort zu duschen. Auch die Vorhänge und Betten waren befleckt und schmutzig. Nach Rücksprache mit dem Hostelpersonal wurde uns mitgeteilt, dass Reinigungsmittel zur Verfügung stehen. Ganz ehrlich: Es ist zwar ein Hostel und man erwartet keinen Luxus, aber zu verlangen, dass Gäste selbst den Dreck anderer beseitigen, weil das Housekeeping nicht hinterherkommt, ist schlichtweg frech. Alles in allem kann ich nur sagen: Verlasst euch nicht auf die positiven Bewertungen dieses Hostels – sie spiegeln die Realität absolut nicht wider.

Regarding cleaning supplies, these are made available as an optional convenience for guests who wish to tidy personal or shared spaces during peak periods, which is common practice in many hostels. This does not replace our housekeeping service. We also note that our accommodation continues to receive consistent positive feedback from a large number of guests who value the location, affordability, and social atmosphere we provide. That said, we understand that hostel-style accommodation may not be suitable for everyone, particularly those expecting private-hotel standards. reviews.title: HORRÍVEL
reviews.positive_text: Não gostei de absolutamente nada.
reviews.negative_text: O hostel é IMUNDO, bagunçado e feio. Quando você entra no hostel tem um corredorzinho apertado e lotado de malas e não existe ninguem para te recepcionar. A "recepcionista" é uma mini televisão onde fica uma atendente remota, das Filipinas, para fazer seu check in. Não tem ninguem na gerência do hostel para te atender. Entrando para a cozinha e área comum, a coisa piora MUITO. Tudo muito, muito sujo e bagunçado, A cozinha um caos e as geladeiras tão lotadas que era impossível sequer guardar uma água lá dentro. Fiquei em dois quartos pois a primeira noite dividi com amigos. O primeiro quarto estava congelando e não tinha como aumentar o ar, muito menos reclamar com alguém do hostel fantasma. O banheiro era externo, dividido com todo o andar e estava um completo NOJO. IMUNDO, não tenho nem palavras para descrever aquele chiqueiro. O segundo quarto era apenas feminino, ficava no que parecia um anexo ao predio principal e sempre que alguem andava pelo quarto, minha cama tremia pois o chao não tem boa sustentação. O banheiro estava sujo também, mas um pouco menos do que o banheiro externo e o quarto tinha cheiro de mofo. Essa foi a PIOR experiência que tive em um hostel na minha vida. Não gosto de fazer avaliações negativas pois não quero prejudicar ninguém, mas também não posso deixar outras pessoas serem enganadas como fui. Não acredite nas fotos, a realidade é bem diferente e para esse hostel ser considerado RUIM, ainda precisa melhorar muito!

reviews.negative_text: While 4-bed rooms are quite nice, a lot of rooms are simply overcrowded. The Wi-Fi is atrocious, I had to use mobile data to call with my friends back home. reviews.title: DO NOT BOOK HERE!!
reviews.positive_text: Not a thing. You could not pay me to stay here again.
reviews.negative_text: FIRST RED FLAG, the reception staff are on a tiny tablet. They are not on site and most likely out of country, using a green screen of an office setting to try and project some sort of professionalism. SECOND RED FLAG, an older lady checked in before us and had specifically requested a female only room at a different Azzurro Hotel. They had overbooked, had zero beds left, and sent her to Darling Harbour location. She had to accept a room with males because when she requested a discount for the trouble, she was told you can stay at the original "hotel" (that was overbooked) or forfeit your payment because they dont offer refunds. THIRD RED FLAG, We had to get our bedding changed before we could even sit down after a 9 hour drive. There was hair and stains on the linen. NONE of the beds had been changed before our arrival. The listing says it is a HOTEL. It is barely a hostel. We booked a Private Room with shared toilet/shower, which reads as shared between the 4 people in the room. It is communal showers and toilets in the middle of the building. The room has an air-conditioner but the staff have the remote, for reasons unknown. We had to call and ask them to send the staff member to change the temperature because the AC was set to fan only. When they arrived, they acted like they couldnt work out the remote. We had to ask for the remote and change the settings ourselves The showers and toilets stank and were just nasty. Do yourself a favour and steer well clear of Azzurro Hotel. The place is a joke.

reviews.positive_text: Honestly, not much this time. I've stayed here before and it was acceptable at the time, hence why I decided to give it a second chance. But after my second stay, I can definitely say never again.
reviews.negative_text: The idea of a hostel with staff working offsite is such a stupid idea. Issues don't get resolved as they don’t respond to messages and they take no accountability. The locks are a joke at both entrance to hostel and room. Terribly designed and rarely work. When you first enter the hostel, there's around 50-100 left bags of luggage just haphazardly dumped throughout the hostel foyer. Massive safety issue. Especially when power isn't working; which was the case when I arrived. They enforce you to fill out lots of paperwork before arrival, fiat enough. But then do nothing to make sure guests are doing the right thing. In my room, had one person who had their phone speaker going for ages, ignoring other guests to turn it off. So no one got much sleep. To make matters worse, this person was leaving snotty tissues all over floor and also had a plate of food left lying in the room. Now I understand why there were so many cockroaches. But when I told staff, my messages were ignored. Bathrooms and few and far between and don't indicate if someone is already inside. So once you do finally get to shower and/or go to the toilet, be prepared for droves of other guests continously trying to turn the knob to get in. There's more but it's easier to just say go find a better hostel than this. Especially one that has staff actually in the building to help you.

reviews.title: I hated my stay here, do yourself a favour and book a YHA instead (the price isn't much different)
reviews.negative_text: I booked a 2 night stay and left after 1 night. 1) The photos look good and it has an overall good rating calls itself a “Pod Hotel”- do not be fooled! Price attractive includes breakfast and dinner, honestly I think you're better off booking into a lovely YHA and getting some bread or cereal yourself! My room wasn’t anything like the photos. 2) No staff at reception, communicate though a monitor screen. The luggage storage is an open room, not secure at all. Communal areas were smelly and dirty. 4) Location inconvenient getting to and from the hostel and quite a sketchy area 6) I had a 4 bed dorm to myself as no one else had booked but it was SO depressing in there. The room smelt of damp and it looked like there was mould on the curtains . I woke up with a chesty cough (also cold in there) 7) The aircon was in the room set to 23 degrees, I asked staff at around 9pm and they said there should be a remote in the room, there wasn’t so they said they’ll send someone. They 2 hours later (around 11pm) and I asked them to switch airon off he refused saying it would get too hot. It was Autumn. He said to call if too cold, so I did they said someone will come. They came just before 1AM to switch it off. I was sleeping. 8) I did not want to stay another night so I left in the morning and was refused a refund for the night I wasn’t staying. I gave numerous opportunities to resolve this but I think it’s important to leave an honest review. I’ve stayed in many hostels internationally and I will take bad reviews with a pinch of salt if photos and rating seems good, but I think this is the worst I’ve stayed in. The photos are very misleading, it looks nice on the photos but the reality is far from it. The vibe in terms of décor, smell, cleanliness and even other people there is SO depressing. I was so much happier when I went to a YHA instead. 9) Bathrooms are small, so get soaked and gross and not enough of them. Limited characters so had to cut text out.The end.

reviews.positive_text: The food provided was fine. Simple breakfast of cheap cereal with milk, white bread for toast with either jam or peanut butter, and tea/coffee/juice. Dinner was pretty basic, like being on a school camp. Plenty of food to fill you up, but lacking in quality and nutrition. The bed was reasonably comfortable, but a challenge getting into the top bunk.
reviews.negative_text: Not very good. Surprised at the overall quite high ratings. The pictures were clearly taken when renovations were new and everything was crisp and nice. Now it's generally pretty run down and grotty. Everything's a little bit dirty, especially the bathrooms which definitely need a deep clean. Also some of the bathrooms have issues like broken showers. There is minimal storage options in the bedroom, some hooks and more/bigger cupboards would've been nice. The bunk bed itself was nice enough to sleep in but limited beside fixtures (ie no shelf or fixed light) make it less than ideal. Reception is entirely remote. The online check-in wasn't working when I arrived and was left waiting for someone to respond to my messages. Especially difficult when you've just arrived in the country and don't have proper phone/internet access yet. Also the need to upload signed pdf forms and ID to stay after payment and confirmation has come through its a nuisance. All in all I felt like I'd walked into a poor house rather than a "hotel" as they call themselves. I understand it is cheap accommodation but don't get your hopes up. I was definitely disappointed and won't be staying here again except as a last resort.

reviews.title: Great location and comfortable. Awesome for the price.
reviews.positive_text: Check-in was easy. The beds were comfortable, and the bathrooms were never crowded. The rooms were quiet, nice and dark. They offered cereals, milk, coffee, juice, bread, spreads, and jams. You could keep your things in the fridge and have full access to the kitchen to prepare whatever else you wanted. Was great to come home to a warm meal, as dinner is included in the package. The staff was always super nice. Great location.
reviews.negative_text: At the first day, getting there was difficult on foot. Coming from the Central Station, it is easy to get lost even using Google Maps because the Harbour has many bridges and stairs. Maybe they should advise people to use public transportation on the first day or have a better map of the area with clear instructions on how to navigate those bridges if you are trying to walk to the place coming from the Central Station. I walked by myself at 11 PM. I did not feel unsafe at all, but what was supposed to be a 20-minute walk turned into a 40-minute walk because I kept getting lost so I had to stop and ask around. The furniture and carpets are not that new anymore (as the pictures show).

reviews.title: Bad
reviews.negative_text: Al no haber personal fisico en la recepcion, se colaba gente en las habitaciones con la reserva de otras personas. Hable con el personal de recepcion que estan virtualmente a traves de un ipad e intente que resolvieran el problema de tener muchas personas que sabian el codigo de entrada de mi habitacion y que eran desconocidos para ellos ya que no me sentia segura. Me mandaron una foto de la persona que habia hecho la reserva y les dije que esa no era la persona que estaba en mi habitacion. La solucion que me dieron es que me podian cambiar a una habitacion con mas personas en vez de investigar quien era el intruso o cambiarlo a el de habitacion y cambiar el codigo de entrada a la nuestra. Las fotos son del alojamiento cuando abrio, ahora todo estaba sucio, viejo y roto. La comida en las fotos parece un buffet pero es un plato que te sirven como si estuvieras en el comedor del colegio. Una tarde me encontraba descansando en mi cama cuando entro el personal de limpieza en la habitacion porque se habian ido dos personas. No se dio cuenta de que yo estaba alli y pude ver claramente como estiraba las sabanas usadas de los anteriores huespedes y dedicaba el resto del tiempo a mirar su movil para luego salir sin haber cambiado nada. Esa noche vinieron dos personas nuevas y usaron las mismas sabanas que los anteriores.

reviews.title: cheap place to sleep, spend your awake time somewhere else
reviews.positive_text: It is a very cheap option to have a place to sleep in Sydney and the location is near a tram station, so if you're not keen on good bathrooms or otherwise pleasant amenities, then go for it. The beds have curtains and you have some kind of privacy. Bring earplugs and a sleepmask anyway. Be prepared to spend all your waking hours some other place, though.
reviews.negative_text: Breakfast is literally only white toast, jam and peanut butter, as well as cereal and milk. The dinner could have been prison food ( I got the vegetarian option). I guess it's free - yay? The property is run-down, not very clean, the bathrooms only have those rain-shower heads with poor water pressure, so washing long hair is a pain. My room smelled bad, and I think a lot of the people staying there are not actually travellers but people who make a living with Uber Eats, because the big Uber Eats backpacks were everywhere, in the rooms, and also clogging up space in the very tiny luggage room. Stairs are crooked, the carpet needs some deep cleaning, check-in is done via a qr-code (there is no actual reception, just a little monitor with someone remote - I am not kidding). They did not have any extra blankets available, so I was very cold at night.

The bathrooms weren’t the best and luckily I was only there for 1 night because I think I would have felt more dirty than clean if I had taken a shower there. There’s breakfast and dinner included but I did not eat there. But I was there around dinner time and there were people sat on the stairs eating and it just seemed very chaotic and nothing is explained at all. Yes it may be cheap and include the food but I have paid the same price to stay in other places minus the food where it’s at least been clean and I’ve felt safe which I would take over having the food.

reviews.hotel_response: Hi Nerea, Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We're genuinely sorry to hear that your stay did not meet your expectations and that you left feeling disappointed. We take cleanliness and guest satisfaction very seriously, and we regret that your experience did not reflect our usual standards. We’re glad our team was able to promptly assist you by relocating you to an alternative accommodation when concerns were raised. We would also like to clarify that we offer a complimentary light breakfast, which includes items like toast, spreads, cereal, and hot drinks—intended as a simple, self-serve option to start the day. We understand it may not suit everyone’s preferences, and your comments will help us evaluate how we can improve the setup and replenishment process. Regarding check-in, while we operate a contactless system for convenience, our remote reception team is available 24/7 via phone, WhatsApp, email, and live chat. This allows us to respond more quickly and flexibly to guest needs than having an on-site receptionist with limited hours. Your feedback has been shared with our operations team to ensure any issues are addressed, and we sincerely appreciate you bringing your concerns to our attention. Wishing you all the best in your future travels.

reviews.title: Justo pelo preço
reviews.positive_text: A localização é boa. A princípio a qualidade-preço é correta. É um bom local para ficar, perto de tudo e por um preço justo - uma vez que “inclui” duas refeições.
reviews.negative_text: O jantar incluído, aqui mostra fotografias como se fosse um buffet. Sao fotos enganadoras, uma vez que a comida é servida no prato. Uma só vez, sem repetição. Ao pequeno-almoço só dão 2 fatias de pão. Mas, como escrevi acima, o preço justifica isso - poucos hostels dão comida!! Provavelmente se estivesse em buffet, não haveria comida para toda a gente. Assim controlam melhor as coisas. Muita gente vive em permanência neste hostel o que faz com que os quartos estejam atolados de malas gigantes. Estive num dormitório feminino com 14 camas e uma casa de banho, um pequeno caixote do lixo... assim é fácil o local ficar insuportável. Duvido que o chão do quarto alguma vez seja limpo, uma vez que está coberto com malas e mochilas e roupas dos que lá vivem. Foi o hostel mais fraco onde fiquei: mas mais uma vez provavelmente tem um preço justo para o que oferece. Mas comparando com outros da Australia, está abaixo do que mostra nas imagens. Não tem ninguém na receção. Falamos por mensagem e alguém nos entrega as coisas. Demoraram duas semanas a devolver o dinheiro da caução da toalha e secador de cabelo.

Die Bilder müsst ihr euch 10x schlimmer vorstellen und richtig heruntergekommen. Ich habe dort niemanden arbeiten gesehen. Ich glaube einer hat dort gewohnt, der nicht mal Gast ist, aber es fällt ja niemanden auf, weil niemand da arbeitet.
reviews.hotel_response: Dear Diyar, Thank you for sharing your feedback with us. We appreciate the opportunity to address your concerns and ensure a more comfortable stay for our future guests. We take cleanliness very seriously, and our professional cleaning service starts at 6:00 AM and continues throughout the day to ensure that all bathrooms are well-maintained and ready for use. Additionally, we have an in-house plumber who is available to maintain the showers and other facilities on the property. If any issues had been brought to our attention during your stay, we would have addressed them promptly. We understand you stayed in our 4-bed ensuite room, and we want to assure you that the bathroom in this area is regularly maintained by our cleaning staff. However, if anything was overlooked, we will certainly investigate and make sure it is addressed moving forward. For your convenience, we also provide lockers for storing valuables and there is plenty of space under the bed for additional storage. Regarding breakfast, we offer complimentary servings for all guests. If you would like a larger portion, feel free to request it, and we’ll be happy to accommodate. We serve two portions to ensure that everyone has enough. Finally, as with any hostel, we strive to maintain a high standard of service by providing complimentary breakfast and dinner. We kindly ask that guests clean the cutlery after use to help us maintain this service and avoid the need for additional charges. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again soon. Should you have any further questions or concerns, please don’t hesitate to reach out. Best Regards, Azzurro Pod Hotel

The location is unbeatable—it’s a stone's throw from ICC and a short walk to the National Museum. Meals here are delightful, with a range of options to satisfy any craving. My room was immaculate, with clean bedsheets and a sparkling bathroom that looked like it had just been renovated. I also noticed the staff followed a strict cleaning routine, ensuring all common areas were spotless. This property offers incredible value for money, and I wouldn’t hesitate to book again.

reviews.title: Bad
reviews.negative_text: Terrible experience in everything. I never leave negative reviews but I had a really bad time. First, the room was for 15 people with a very small window and an equally small bathroom. (Imagine the cleanliness of a bathroom that is used by 15 people). Everyone's clothes thrown on the floor and also food, the rules were not respected by anyone. I had bought a bar of dark chocolate for breakfast and left it on my shelf and it was stolen, the next day it was gone. Dinner was the same as the hospitals, and the front desk opens later and closes earlier than the marked times. I felt locked in a prison. Absolutely not recommended.
reviews.hotel_response: Hi Alessia, We’re sorry to hear that your stay did not meet your expectations. As a shared accommodation, we strive to maintain cleanliness and order, but we also rely on guests to follow house rules regarding tidiness and shared spaces. Our housekeeping team follows strict cleaning protocols, but with multiple guests using common facilities, individual habits can vary. Regarding security, we encourage guests to store personal belongings securely, as we cannot monitor individual items left in shared spaces. Additionally, our front desk team operates within the listed hours, though remote support is available 24/7 for any urgent concerns. We regret that our setup wasn’t the right fit for you, but we appreciate your feedback as it helps us improve the guest experience.

Many of our guests enjoy the spacious dining area after dinner, and we also have a lovely courtyard at the back for fresh air and relaxation. We strive to create a comfortable environment for all guests, balancing social interaction with rest. To ensure a pleasant stay for everyone, we kindly ask guests to keep noise levels low after 10 PM to maintain a peaceful atmosphere for a good night’s sleep. We appreciate your feedback and look forward to hosting you again!
